summary_en: The video documents a free swimming class program in Thu Duc City where children are taught swimming and water survival skills by instructors at an outdoor pool. It features footage of kids practicing swimming exercises, interviews with organizers about the initiative's purpose, and scenes of instructors evaluating participants and awarding certificates upon course completion.
